correlation_analysis.analysis_summary: The analysis focused on creating high-confidence mappings between log events and MITRE ATT&CK techniques. The retrieved techniques were prioritized, and direct semantic matches were sought. Only mappings with a confidence score of 0.5 or higher were included. The overall mapping quality is considered good, with several strong correlations identified.

direct_mappings.event_description: A new process was created: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe with an encoded command. Parent process is wscript.exe
direct_mappings.mapping_rationale: The event clearly indicates the execution of PowerShell with an encoded command, which aligns directly with the PowerShell technique. The parent process wscript.exe further strengthens this correlation.
recommendations: Decode the PowerShell command to understand its purpose.
Investigate the wscript.exe process and its origin.
Monitor for similar PowerShell executions with encoded commands.

direct_mappings.event_description: A new process was created: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe with an encoded command. Parent process is wscript.exe
direct_mappings.mapping_rationale: Given the use of wscript.exe as a parent process to launch powershell, it is possible that SyncAppvPublishingServer.vbs is being abused to proxy the execution of malicious PowerShell commands.
recommendations: Examine the script being executed by wscript.exe.
Determine if SyncAppvPublishingServer.vbs is involved in the execution chain.
Monitor for similar patterns of wscript.exe launching PowerShell.
